findings.note: Secondary finding (TTLBufferEntriesMax dead metric) mentioned in the ticket was left untouched, as the ticket only suggested it as a possible follow-up ('worth fixing or removing') and Option A was the suggested immediate fix for the primary issue. Option B (sample rename) was explicitly left as an open follow-up decision by the ticket, so it was not implemented.

parameters.summary: Implemented Option A from the ticket: guarded the MergeGraphSizeMax gauge report site in pkg/service/batch_processor.go so it only fires when ctx.maxGraphSize > 0, preventing merge-less batches from clobbering the gauge with zeros. This is a same-name, same-type, same-registration fix with no downstream changes, as suggested as the immediate low-risk fix in the ticket. The ticket explicitly left Option B (renaming to a Sample-based metric) as an open follow-up decision, and the secondary TTLBufferEntriesMax dead-metric finding as optional further work, so neither was addressed. Ran the project's check, which passed.
